thread:
maya: Hey folks — noticed dashboard counts go to zero when I apply model+version filters together for EU region. If I only pick region=eu it's fine.

ash: @maya can you paste the exact filter string you used? screenshots help.

maya: Sure — repro url: https://console.redwood.local/analytics?region=eu&model=redwood/gptx-1&version=canary-2026-02
Screenshot: https://img.internal/redwood/snap123.png

ash: thx. Quick check — does the data show up if you remove the `version` param?

maya: Yes. region+model works. Only when version is present the charts become empty.

liam: tagging eng-runtime. I ran the query against metrics API: `GET /v1/metrics?region=eu&model=redwood/gptx-1&version=canary-2026-02&interval=1h` and got back 200 but payload `buckets: []`.

liam: digging into logs — saw several `filter_normalizer: dropped unknown key 'version_alias'` entries around the time of the request.

zara: does this line up with the normalization rollout last week? we changed alias -> version precedence to prefer canonical ids. possible regression.

ash: @liam can you paste small excerpt of the router log? no PIIs, just keys.

liam: log snippet: `2026-02-18T14:03:12Z | req=abcd | filters_in: {region: eu, model: redwood/gptx-1, version: canary-2026-02} | normalized: {region: eu, model: redwood/gptx-1} | dropped: ['version'] | reason: unknown_version_format`

maya: interesting — the UI was sending `version` as `canary-2026-02` which is the alias, not the canonical sha. previously that worked. customer affected (ticket SUP-7621) is seeing missing consumption charts.

customer-svc: Customer on call right now. They reported spike in errors too but main pain is billing dashboard showing no usage for that model-version.

zara: probable root: normalizer recently started strict-matching for `version` and strips unrecognized aliases instead of mapping via alias table. We'll need a hotfix which treats alias tokens as valid and resolves them.

ash: workaround for customers: use exact model version id (e.g., `gptx-1@sha256:abcd...`) OR remove version filter. I'll add a Console banner / help text with that note.

liam: created hotfix branch `fix/version-alias-resolve`. tests added for alias->canonical resolution in metric filters. I also queued a canary deploy to staging. deploy-bot: canary started for eng-runtime/staging.

deploy-bot: deploy 36f2 started (staging). watchers: @liam @ash @zara.

ash: ETA for prod rollback/hotfix? we should aim <4h if tests pass.

zara: agree. if staging looks good we'll push to prod in ~90m with a small traffic lane. I'll update SUP-7621 with status.

maya: thanks team, customer notified. :thumbsup:
__notes: This thread documents a console filtering bug where version aliases are dropped during normalization causing empty analytics when model+version+region filters are applied. Includes repro URL, logs, workaround, and engineering plan.
